scope: Find the first genuine SIL India or Pakistan survey in census order with affirmative evidence of published lexical or wordlist material that is neither installed nor represented by an active or complete source-local package.
policy: Published lexical evidence is a selection condition, not transcription evidence. A primary report must be acquired, checksummed, rendered, and visually inspected before page/list/cell topology is claimed. Image-only or handwritten IPA must be transcribed manually cell by cell; OCR, PDF text, legacy imports, and secondary sources may locate but never supply or verify a reading.

active_acquisition_packages.reason_not_selected: The source is already represented by an active source-local discovery/acquisition package, so it fails the selection condition.
active_acquisition_packages.unresolved_coordinates: All 79 manuscript pages and every alleged comparative-wordlist page, list, and cell remain unresolved until the exact primary manuscript is acquired.

glottolog_reconciliation.partial_manual_scope: Bangladesh only; none is an India or Pakistan candidate for this lane.
glottolog_reconciliation.result: Every genuine India or Pakistan record in the explicit-country Glottolog audit is installed, a covered component of an installed series, a duplicate reissue, or an inspected report without published lexical rows.

selection.unresolved_coordinates: No new report was selected, so no report-page, list, or cell coordinates may be asserted. The Kinnauri coordinates remain explicitly unresolved in its existing source-local discovery package.
selection.reason: All 57 India/Pakistan census rows are installed, represented by complete source-local packages, verified to publish no ingestible lexical rows, or—in the sole Kinnauri case—already represented by an active acquisition package.

next_action: Do not invent a replacement candidate. Resume the existing Kinnauri acquisition package if the exact 79-page primary manuscript is obtained, or extend the discovery census with a newly evidenced SIL India/Pakistan archival object before beginning extraction. Any new primary report must be checksummed and rendered before topology is frozen and any image-only IPA is manually transcribed.
